note: Evidence-first owner mirror. A rendered page, running process, prior PASS, or stale queue item is not acceptance.

sections.name: SAMERAI Core
sections.detail: Owner truth board has been reduced to evidence-first primary realities. Relay and public-key endpoints were reachable in the current browser session. Private paired command execution is not accepted.
sections.action: Keep owner surface minimal; prove private command round-trip before promoting it.

sections.name: Universal Graph
sections.detail: Historical graph counts exist, but no fresh owner-usable graph journey was verified in this recovery pass.
sections.action: Do not spend recovery capacity here until BPC, storage, transport, and MyOffice owner journeys close.

sections.name: BPC / Lebanon Map
sections.detail: A real parcel journey is now verified end-to-end on the public mobile map: Ain Mreisseh Lot 322 resolves to BEY-AIN_MREISSEH-322, renders controlled geometry, shows 9,758 m², Zone 3, controlled authority, Street View and share action. The parcel-detail proxy rejection was repaired. Nationwide/mobile acceptance is not yet closed.
sections.action: Expand destructive testing across representative Beirut parcels and fix only failures that break search, polygon render, facts, zoning evidence or owner actions.

sections.name: MyOffice

sections.name: Review.Properties

sections.action: Defer new surface work; reconnect only to verified BPC and brokerage/appraisal workflows after core recovery.

sections.name: Meta / WhatsApp
sections.detail: Prior paid-media evidence remains historical and is not being treated as a current acceptance signal during core recovery.
sections.action: Maintain existing campaigns without architecture expansion; reverify routing when core recovery capacity permits.

sections.name: BOSSPC Storage
sections.detail: Fresh C: reading: 408.61 GB used and 37.92 GB free. This is about 8.7 GB less used than the previous 417.3 GB reading, but the growth source is still not proven. A read-only recent-large-file census was started; no deletion was performed.
sections.action: Finish size and growth attribution, identify the creating process/file class, hash suspected duplicates, then remove only proven disposable data.

sections.name: BossHome / BOSSPC Transport
sections.detail: BOSSPC accepted several live Desktop Commander commands in this recovery pass, then the command channel became intermittent again. BossHome remains offline from the current device registry view. Heartbeat is not being conflated with reliable command transport.
sections.action: Treat transport reliability as a root-cause blocker; restore repeatable command/filesystem round-trips before depending on remote execution loops.

sections.name: Supabase Control / Data API
sections.detail: The BPC public proxy Edge Function was successfully redeployed in this recovery pass and now allows parcel-core reads. Broader database/control health was not freshly reverified here.
sections.action: Use only freshly verified endpoints; do not carry forward prior outage assumptions as current truth.

sections.action: Route by task only after the canonical test/evidence gate is defined; one integrator promotes changes.
